messages:
mike: Scheduling a schema migration tonight 23:00 UTC for orders.payment_method (varchar -> enum). Backfill ~10M rows.

mike: Want a DeployBot holdpoint if locks > 120s OR replica lag > 30s. Also want a clear rollback trigger and version pin in release notes.

deploybot: deploybot: Created migration job mg-20260322-01. Default canary 5%. You can add holdpoint conditions with `/deploy holdpoint add mg-20260322-01 --cond "lock>120s OR repl_lag>30s"`.

anya: +1 on holdpoint. Can we also pin webservice to 2.7.1 during rollout? release notes should mention toggles and data migration id. :thumbsup:

elaine: Recommend a single-shard canary first (shard=orders_shard_3) then 10% traffic, validate reads + writes for 10m before wider roll.

sam: Rollback criteria idea: if backfill throughput < 500 rows/s for 15m OR error rate for orders.write > 0.5% -> abort and rollback. Also escape hatch: flip feature flag `orders_v2` to false.

irfan: Monitoring queries to watch during run:
```
-- active locks on ALTERs
SELECT now()-pg_stat_activity.query_start AS age, pid, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state='active' AND query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE orders%';

-- simple replication lag (seconds) example
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - coalesce(replay_timestamp, now())) AS lag_seconds
FROM replication_status LIMIT 1;
```

irfan: I'll add a Grafana panel for lock age + backfill rows/sec.

mike: Good. Who's owning the rollback runbook if we hit the holdpoint?

elaine: I'll own rollback steps (db restore not expected). Plan is: 1) pause backfill, 2) pin app to previous version, 3) run targeted fixback on failed rows, 4) resume. I'll draft runbook in GH and link.

sam: Add an actionable safety step: `/deploy abort mg-20260322-01 --reason "lock-threshold"` should trigger automatic pause of writes to migration queue and send alert.

deploybot: deploybot: Holdpoint added to mg-20260322-01 -> cond: lock>120s OR repl_lag>30s; abort_cmd=/deploy abort mg-20260322-01 --reason lock-threshold. Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #eng-oncall.

oncallbot: oncallbot: Alert rule created: replication_lag > 25s for 5m -> notify @oncall and #eng-oncall.

anya: I'll update release notes: include migration id mg-20260322-01, pinned service 2.7.1, canary plan, rollback steps, monitor queries.

mike: thanks. Tag me when the GH runbook is up. I'll schedule the maintenance window in calendar.

elaine: Draft runbook link: https://git.redwood/internal/runbooks/mg-20260322-01 (will post when ready). :rocket:

sam: quick check: if we see lock spikes but low replica lag, do we still abort? we set OR condition so yes, but we might want a short grace (2m) — confirm.

mike: yes, grace window 2m for lock>120s, 5m for repl_lag>30s. Update deploybot cond to reflect that.

deploybot: deploybot: Updated holdpoint -> cond: lock>120s for 2m OR repl_lag>30s for 5m. Canary: shard=orders_shard_3 5% -> 10% -> 100% staged.

irfan: I'll validate dashboards and add a heartbeat metric for backfill rows/sec.

oncallbot: oncallbot: Scheduled alert test at 22:45 UTC.

mike: perfect. meeting adjourned unless something new pops up.
